security.title: Exposed database credentials
security.detect: Search config, code, CI files, container images and history for connection strings with embedded passwords; check whether the DB port is reachable from the public internet.
security.remediate: Move credentials to a secret manager or runtime environment; rotate any exposed credential (human approval); restrict DB network access.
security.verification: Re-scan working tree and history; confirm the old credential no longer authenticates; confirm DB port unreachable from outside the allowed network.

security.title: Public .env files
security.detect: Check that .env* is git-ignored and absent from build output, Docker contexts and web roots; request /.env on a deployed test host.
security.remediate: Add .env* to .gitignore and .dockerignore; keep only a placeholder .env.example; configure the web server to deny dotfiles.
security.verification: Fetch /.env and variants against the deployed build: expect 403/404 and no secret content. Confirm `git ls-files` lists no real .env.

security.title: Hardcoded secrets
security.detect: Run a dedicated secret scanner (e.g. gitleaks, trufflehog, detect-secrets) plus entropy and keyword review of source, tests, notebooks and IaC.
security.remediate: Replace literals with environment or secret-manager lookups; fail fast at startup when a required secret is missing; rotate exposed values.
security.verification: Scanner reports zero verified findings (document allowlisted false positives); app fails clearly when a secret is unset.

security.title: Weak authentication
security.detect: Review password policy, hashing algorithm, login flow, lockout, and any custom auth code that replaces a vetted library.
security.remediate: Use a maintained auth library or identity provider; hash with Argon2id, scrypt or bcrypt; enforce length-based policy and breach-password checks.
security.verification: Unit/integration tests for hashing parameters, lockout/throttle behaviour and rejection of weak passwords.

security.title: Missing authorization checks
security.detect: Enumerate every route/handler/action and mark which check identity and which check permission; look for handlers with no check.
security.remediate: Enforce authorization server-side, deny by default, centralise policy in middleware or policy functions.
security.verification: Per-endpoint tests: anonymous, wrong-role and correct-role requests return 401/403/200 as designed.

security.title: Cross-user access
security.detect: Trace each data read/write to see whether the owner or tenant is derived from the session or from client input.
security.remediate: Derive user/tenant from the authenticated session; scope every query by owner; add DB-level row security where supported.
security.verification: Two-account test: user A cannot read, update or delete user B's records through any endpoint.

security.title: Open database permissions
security.detect: Inspect DB roles, grants, row-level-security status, public buckets/collections, and network rules (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0).
security.remediate: Create least-privilege roles per service; enable row-level security or equivalent; close public network access.
security.verification: Connect with the application role and confirm only intended tables/operations succeed; external connection attempts fail.

security.title: Cloud service misconfiguration
security.detect: Review IaC and console exports for public storage, wide IAM policies, disabled encryption/logging, open security groups. Use IaC scanners where available (e.g. checkov, tfsec/trivy).
security.remediate: Apply least-privilege IAM, private-by-default storage, encryption at rest, logging enabled; manage via reviewed IaC.
security.verification: Re-run IaC scanner and attach output; confirm with a read-only cloud inspection (human-approved) that live state matches IaC.

security.title: Unprotected admin routes
security.detect: List admin/internal routes (/admin, /internal, /debug, framework admin panels) and test them unauthenticated and as a normal user.
security.remediate: Require authentication plus an admin role check on every admin route; restrict by network or VPN where possible; require MFA for admins.
security.verification: Automated test that anonymous and non-admin requests to each admin route are rejected.

security.title: Exposed production debug tools
security.detect: Look for DEBUG=true, debug toolbars, profilers, /actuator, /_debug, GraphQL introspection or playgrounds, Swagger UI enabled in production.
security.remediate: Gate debug features on environment; disable or authenticate diagnostic endpoints; separate prod and dev config.
security.verification: Request known debug paths on the production-like build and confirm 401/403/404; confirm DEBUG is false in effective config.

security.title: Secrets in logs
security.detect: Search logging calls for request bodies, headers, tokens, connection strings, and objects serialized whole; inspect sample logs.
security.remediate: Add redaction in the logger (authorization, cookie, password, token, key fields); log identifiers not payloads.
security.verification: Test that a request containing a canary secret never appears in captured log output.

security.title: Verbose production errors
security.detect: Trigger errors in a production-mode build and check for stack traces, SQL, file paths, framework banners.
security.remediate: Return generic error bodies with a correlation ID; log detail server-side only; set production error handlers.
security.verification: Force 400/404/500 conditions and assert response bodies contain no stack trace, path or query text.

security.title: Secrets in Git history
security.detect: Scan full history and all branches/tags (e.g. gitleaks/trufflehog in git mode), including deleted files.
security.remediate: Rotate the secret first (human approval). History rewriting is optional, destructive and needs explicit approval; deletion from HEAD alone is not a fix.
security.verification: History scan shows no active secrets; the exposed credential is confirmed revoked.

security.title: Secrets in frontend JavaScript
security.detect: Inspect built bundles, HTML, source maps and public env prefixes (NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_) for private keys or privileged tokens.
security.remediate: Move privileged calls to a backend; only publishable/public keys may reach the client; rotate leaked keys.
security.verification: Grep production build output for known secret patterns and key names; confirm the client works using only public keys.

security.title: Client-only security
security.detect: Find checks that exist only in UI code (hidden buttons, client-side role flags, JS validation, price calculations).
security.remediate: Re-implement every check on the server; treat client state as untrusted input.
security.verification: Bypass the UI (curl or API client) and confirm the server still rejects the forbidden action.

security.title: Missing or weak input validation
security.detect: Map all inputs (body, query, headers, files, webhooks, env) and check for schema validation on type, length, range and format.
security.remediate: Validate at the boundary with a schema library; allowlist formats; reject unknown fields; validate again on the server.
security.verification: Negative tests with malformed, oversized, wrong-type and boundary values return 4xx and never reach business logic.

security.title: SQL injection
security.detect: Find string-built SQL (concatenation, f-strings, template literals) and ORM raw-query escapes; use SAST rules.
security.remediate: Use parameterised queries/prepared statements; allowlist dynamic identifiers; least-privilege DB role.
security.verification: Regression test with injection payloads against each query path; static scan shows no string-built SQL.

security.title: NoSQL injection
security.detect: Look for query objects built directly from request JSON (e.g. operators like $ne, $gt, $where) and unsanitised filters.
security.remediate: Validate types so operators cannot be injected; strip/deny $-prefixed keys; avoid server-side JS evaluation.
security.verification: Send operator payloads in login and filter endpoints and confirm rejection.

security.title: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
security.detect: Find innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, v-html, unescaped template output, unsafe URL attributes, and markdown/HTML rendering of user content.
security.remediate: Use context-aware output encoding; prefer framework auto-escaping; sanitise rich HTML with a maintained sanitizer; add a Content-Security-Policy.
security.verification: Inject test payloads in every stored/reflected field and confirm they render inert; CSP report-only then enforce.

security.title: Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
security.detect: Identify state-changing endpoints relying on cookie auth without CSRF tokens or SameSite protection.
security.remediate: Use framework CSRF tokens or double-submit pattern, SameSite=Lax/Strict cookies, and Origin/Referer checks; never mutate on GET.
security.verification: Cross-origin form/fetch test without token is rejected; token round trip succeeds.

security.title: Insecure file uploads
security.detect: Review upload handlers for type/size checks, storage location, filename use, execution permissions and public access.
security.remediate: Allowlist types by content not extension; cap size; generate server-side names; store outside web root or in private object storage; scan if risk warrants; serve with safe Content-Type and Content-Disposition.
security.verification: Upload test files (oversized, wrong type, double extension, traversal name) and confirm rejection; confirm uploaded files are not executable.

security.title: Path traversal
security.detect: Find file reads/writes/serves built from user input (path join, send_file, archive extraction).
security.remediate: Resolve to canonical path and verify it stays inside an allowed base directory; use ID-to-path lookup rather than raw names; safe archive extraction.
security.verification: Tests with ../, encoded and absolute path payloads return 4xx and never touch files outside the base.

security.title: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
security.detect: Find server-side fetches of user-supplied URLs (previews, webhooks, importers, image proxies).
security.remediate: Allowlist destinations; resolve DNS and block private, loopback, link-local and metadata ranges after redirects; disable or re-validate redirects; enforce timeouts and size limits.
security.verification: Tests against localhost, 169.254.169.254, private ranges, DNS-rebinding style hostnames and redirects to them are all blocked.

security.title: Broken password reset flows
security.detect: Review token generation, expiry, single use, storage, delivery, host-header trust and session invalidation after reset.
security.remediate: Use high-entropy single-use tokens stored hashed, short expiry, constant responses regardless of account existence, invalidate sessions after reset.
security.verification: Tests: reused, expired and tampered tokens fail; response identical for known/unknown emails; old sessions revoked.

security.title: Weak session management
security.detect: Review session ID generation, rotation on login, idle/absolute timeout, logout invalidation and storage.
security.remediate: Use framework session management; regenerate ID on privilege change; enforce timeouts; server-side invalidate on logout.
security.verification: Tests: session fixation attempt fails; logout invalidates server-side; expired sessions rejected.

security.title: Exposed or weak JWT secrets and validation
security.detect: Check secret strength/location, algorithm pinning, alg=none handling, exp/aud/iss validation, key rotation and token storage.
security.remediate: Use strong secrets or asymmetric keys from a secret manager; pin allowed algorithms; validate exp, iss, aud; keep access tokens short-lived.
security.verification: Tests: tampered, unsigned, expired, wrong-audience and wrong-algorithm tokens are rejected.

security.title: Permissive CORS
security.detect: Look for Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials, reflected Origin, overly broad regex origins, null origin.
security.remediate: Allowlist exact origins; never combine wildcard with credentials; restrict methods and headers.
security.verification: Send requests with disallowed Origin headers and confirm no ACAO header; allowed origin returns exact match only.

security.title: Missing or ineffective rate limits
security.detect: Check login, reset, signup, OTP, search, expensive and AI endpoints for throttling; check keying (IP only vs account) and bypass via headers.
security.remediate: Apply per-account and per-IP limits with a shared store; stricter limits on auth and costly endpoints; return 429 with Retry-After.
security.verification: Load test within safe limits on a test environment to confirm 429 occurs and limits survive multiple instances.

security.title: Exposed development and staging environments
security.detect: Enumerate dev/staging hosts and URLs referenced in repo/DNS; check authentication and indexing.
security.remediate: Put non-prod behind SSO/VPN/IP allowlist; use separate data and secrets; add noindex and auth.
security.verification: Unauthenticated request to each non-prod host is denied; no production data present.

security.title: Default credentials
security.detect: Search seeds, docker-compose, README, IaC and admin tools for admin/admin, changeme, example passwords.
security.remediate: Remove defaults; require first-run credential setup; generate random secrets per environment.
security.verification: Attempt documented default logins against a test deployment and confirm failure; seed scripts contain none.

security.title: Unsigned webhooks
security.detect: Check inbound webhook handlers for signature verification using the raw body and a constant-time comparison.
security.remediate: Verify provider signature with the shared secret before processing; reject on failure; fail closed.
security.verification: Tests: missing, invalid and modified-body signatures are rejected; valid signature accepted.

security.title: Frontend-only payment verification
security.detect: Check whether order success, price, entitlement or plan is decided from client redirect/query state.
security.remediate: Confirm payment server-side via provider API or verified webhook; compute prices on the server; grant entitlements only after verified events.
security.verification: Test with provider test mode: forged success redirect without payment grants nothing.

security.title: IDOR / BOLA
security.detect: For every endpoint taking an object ID, check whether ownership/permission is verified for that object.
security.remediate: Authorize per object; use scoped queries; consider unguessable IDs as defence in depth, not as the control.
security.verification: Two-account automated test enumerating ID-bearing endpoints; cross-account access returns 403/404.

security.title: Unsafe APIs accepting untrusted input
security.detect: Review APIs for unvalidated bodies, overly broad filters, unbounded pagination/sorting, and dangerous parameters.
security.remediate: Schema-validate; cap page size; allowlist sort/filter fields; return only needed fields.
security.verification: Fuzz-style tests with oversized, nested and unexpected inputs confirm bounded behaviour.

security.title: Exposed logs
security.detect: Check for publicly reachable log files, log dashboards, storage buckets and verbose log endpoints.
security.remediate: Store logs in access-controlled systems; remove log files from web roots; authenticate dashboards.
security.verification: Unauthenticated access attempts to log paths/dashboards are denied.

security.title: Exposed source maps
security.detect: Check build output and deployed host for *.map files and sourceMappingURL comments.
security.remediate: Disable public source maps in production or upload them privately to error-tracking only.
security.verification: Request known .map URLs on the production build: expect 404; scan dist for sourceMappingURL.

security.title: Vulnerable dependencies
security.detect: Run ecosystem audit tools (npm audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner, cargo audit, etc.) against lockfiles; review transitive depth.
security.remediate: Upgrade or replace vulnerable packages; document accepted risk with expiry; enable automated update PRs for review.
security.verification: Re-run audit after changes and attach output; run the test suite on upgraded versions.

security.title: Malicious packages
security.detect: Review new/changed dependencies for typosquatting, install scripts, unknown maintainers, recent ownership changes.
security.remediate: Remove suspicious packages; require review for new dependencies; use lockfiles with integrity hashes; consider install-script restrictions.
security.verification: Dependency diff reviewed and approved by a human; lockfile integrity verified in CI.

security.title: Prompt injection
security.detect: Identify where untrusted text (web pages, emails, documents, tool output, user input) enters model context alongside instructions and tools.
security.remediate: Separate trusted instructions from untrusted data; minimise tool permissions; require human confirmation for sensitive actions; validate outputs. Prompting alone does not eliminate the risk.
security.verification: Red-team test set of injection payloads; confirm sensitive actions are blocked by code-level controls, not just model compliance.

security.title: Unpermissioned AI access
security.detect: Check what data and tools an AI feature can reach and whether access respects the calling user's permissions.
security.remediate: Run AI actions with the end user's authorization, not a service superuser; scope retrieval by user/tenant.
security.verification: Test that a user cannot obtain another user's data through the AI feature.

security.title: Excessive database permissions
security.detect: Review the DB account used by the app, migrations and AI tools for DDL, superuser or cross-schema rights.
security.remediate: Separate migration and runtime roles; grant minimum table/column privileges; read-only roles for analytics and AI.
security.verification: Attempt a forbidden statement (e.g. DROP) with the runtime role in a test DB: it must fail.

security.title: Missing audit logs
security.detect: Check that logins, permission changes, admin actions, data exports and deletions produce tamper-resistant records.
security.remediate: Add structured audit events (actor, action, target, time, outcome) without sensitive payloads; ship to append-only storage.
security.verification: Perform each audited action in test and confirm one event with required fields.

security.title: Missing security monitoring
security.detect: Check for alerting on auth failures, privilege changes, error spikes, unusual egress and rate-limit hits.
security.remediate: Define alert rules and owners; route to an on-call channel; document runbooks.
security.verification: Trigger a test event and confirm an alert reaches its owner.

security.title: Missing or untested backups
security.detect: Check backup existence, frequency, retention, encryption, off-site copy and last successful restore test.
security.remediate: Automate backups with retention and separate credentials; schedule restore drills; document RPO/RTO.
security.verification: Perform a restore into an isolated environment and record the result; a backup never restored is unverified.

security.title: Exposed internal dashboards
security.detect: Find admin/monitoring tools (Grafana, Kibana, queues, DB UIs, feature-flag consoles) reachable publicly.
security.remediate: Place behind SSO/VPN/allowlist; disable anonymous access; change default credentials.
security.verification: External unauthenticated request to each dashboard returns login/deny.

security.title: Missing security headers
security.detect: Inspect response headers for HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
security.remediate: Set headers at the edge or framework; roll out CSP in report-only first; HSTS only after HTTPS is fully working.
security.verification: Header check against the deployed build (curl -I) and automated test in CI.

security.title: Insecure cookie settings
security.detect: Review Set-Cookie for HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, Path/Domain scope and lifetime.
security.remediate: Set HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite and minimal scope on session cookies; use __Host- prefix where suitable.
security.verification: Inspect Set-Cookie on login in a production-like environment and assert attributes.

security.title: Unencrypted sensitive data
security.detect: Check TLS in transit (including internal), encryption at rest, field-level protection of sensitive data, password storage and key management.
security.remediate: Enforce TLS; enable storage encryption; encrypt high-sensitivity fields with managed keys; hash passwords; plan key rotation.
security.verification: Verify TLS config with a scanner or handshake test; confirm encryption flags in IaC/console; inspect stored values for plaintext.

security.title: Poor tenant isolation
security.detect: Check every query, cache key, file path, search index and background job for tenant scoping.
security.remediate: Enforce tenant scope centrally (middleware, ORM scopes, row-level security); namespace caches and storage.
security.verification: Two-tenant test suite covering API, cache, search, exports and jobs.

security.title: Unreviewed code
security.detect: Check branch protection, required reviews, review of AI-generated code, and CODEOWNERS for sensitive paths.
security.remediate: Require human review before merge, especially for AI-generated changes and security-sensitive paths.
security.verification: Confirm protection settings in the platform and that recent merges had reviews.

security.title: Mass assignment
security.detect: Find code binding request bodies directly to models (e.g. update(**request.json)) allowing fields like role, isAdmin, price.
security.remediate: Use explicit allowlisted DTOs/serializers per operation; mark sensitive fields read-only.
security.verification: Send extra fields (role, tenant_id, is_admin) and confirm they are ignored or rejected.

security.title: Command injection
security.detect: Find shell execution with user input (exec, system, subprocess with shell=True, backticks).
security.remediate: Avoid shells; use argument-array APIs or native libraries; allowlist values.
security.verification: Payload tests with ; | $() and newlines produce no command execution; static scan has no shell=True on tainted input.

security.title: Insecure deserialization
security.detect: Find pickle, yaml.load, Java ObjectInputStream, PHP unserialize, unsafe JSON revivers on untrusted data.
security.remediate: Use safe data formats (JSON with schema); safe loaders; never deserialize untrusted native objects; sign data if state must round trip.
security.verification: Static scan shows no unsafe loaders on untrusted input; malicious-object test is rejected.

security.title: Misconfigured OAuth
security.detect: Review redirect URI validation, state/nonce, PKCE, scope minimisation, token storage, account linking.
security.remediate: Exact-match redirect URIs; require state and PKCE; least scopes; verify ID token claims; safe account linking.
security.verification: Tests: altered redirect URI, missing state and replayed codes are rejected.

security.title: Missing MFA
security.detect: Check whether admins and sensitive accounts can enrol and are required to use MFA; check recovery paths.
security.remediate: Offer TOTP/WebAuthn; require for privileged users; protect recovery flows; avoid SMS-only where feasible.
security.verification: Test that privileged login without second factor fails and recovery cannot bypass it.

security.title: Account enumeration
security.detect: Compare responses, status codes and timing for login, signup and reset with known vs unknown accounts.
security.remediate: Use uniform messages and similar timing; rate limit; avoid confirming existence.
security.verification: Automated comparison of responses for existing vs non-existing accounts shows no distinguishable difference.

security.title: Business logic abuse
security.detect: Model workflows (coupons, credits, refunds, referrals, quotas, negative numbers, step skipping) and look for abuse paths.
security.remediate: Enforce state machines and invariants on the server; limit and monitor high-value actions.
security.verification: Abuse-case tests for each workflow invariant (negative amounts, repeated coupon, skipped step).

security.title: Race conditions
security.detect: Look for check-then-act sequences on balances, inventory, coupons, uniqueness without locks/constraints.
security.remediate: Use transactions, row locks, unique constraints, atomic updates and idempotency keys.
security.verification: Concurrent request test (parallel calls) confirms single success.

security.title: Webhook replay
security.detect: Check for timestamp tolerance and event-ID de-duplication on inbound webhooks.
security.remediate: Reject stale timestamps; store processed event IDs; make handlers idempotent.
security.verification: Replay a captured valid request and confirm it is rejected or has no second effect.

security.title: Insecure CI/CD
security.detect: Review pipeline permissions, secret exposure to forks/PRs, self-hosted runners, script injection through untrusted inputs, deploy credentials.
security.remediate: Least-privilege tokens; no secrets to untrusted PRs; avoid interpolating untrusted data into shell; protect deploy branches and environments.
security.verification: Review workflow files against a checklist/linter (e.g. actionlint, zizmor) and attach output.

security.title: Untrusted build actions
security.detect: Inventory third-party actions, orbs, plugins and base images; check source, maintainers and reference style.
security.remediate: Prefer vetted publishers; pin to full commit SHA or digest; review updates; minimise third-party steps.
security.verification: Lint shows no mutable-tag references for third-party actions; digest pins present for base images.

security.title: Unpinned build dependencies
security.detect: Check for floating versions, missing lockfiles, curl|sh installers, latest tags.
security.remediate: Commit lockfiles; pin versions and hashes; pin image digests; use reproducible build settings.
security.verification: Clean build in CI from lockfile succeeds; diff of lockfile reviewed on updates.

security.title: Security checks that fail open
security.detect: Search for try/except that allows access on error, auth/rate-limit/WAF clients that default to allow on timeout, scanners marked non-blocking.
security.remediate: Fail closed for auth, authorisation, validation and signature checks; alert on check failures.
security.verification: Fault-injection tests: when the check dependency is down, the protected action is denied.

security.title: Missing timeouts
security.detect: Find outbound HTTP, DB, queue and subprocess calls without timeouts and servers without request/body limits.
security.remediate: Set connect/read timeouts, retries with backoff and caps, request size limits, circuit breakers.
security.verification: Test against a slow endpoint confirms the call aborts within the configured limit.

security.title: Sensitive information leakage
security.detect: Check API responses, errors, URLs, referrers, analytics, caches and exports for over-sharing of PII/secrets.
security.remediate: Return minimal fields via explicit response schemas; keep secrets out of URLs; set cache-control on sensitive responses; scrub analytics.
security.verification: Response-schema tests assert absence of sensitive fields; inspect cache headers on sensitive routes.

security.title: Invalid AI output
security.detect: Find places where model output is executed, rendered as HTML, used in SQL/URLs/commands, or trusted as structured data.
security.remediate: Treat output as untrusted: schema-validate, encode for the sink, parameterise queries, allowlist URLs/commands, human confirmation for high impact.
security.verification: Tests feed malformed or hostile model output and confirm sinks reject or neutralise it.

security.title: Excessive AI permissions
security.detect: Inventory tools, tokens, file/network/shell access given to agents or AI features.
security.remediate: Grant least privilege, scoped short-lived credentials, sandbox execution, allowlisted commands, approval gates for destructive or external actions.
security.verification: Permission review table plus test showing denied actions are blocked by the platform, not only by prompt.

security.title: Sensitive browser storage
security.detect: Check localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB/cookies for tokens, PII or secrets.
security.remediate: Prefer HttpOnly cookies for session credentials; avoid storing sensitive data client-side; clear on logout.
security.verification: Inspect browser storage after login/logout in a test run and assert no sensitive values.

security.title: Open redirects
security.detect: Find redirects driven by next/returnTo/url parameters, including OAuth flows.
security.remediate: Allowlist destinations or accept only relative paths; validate after parsing; avoid reflecting raw URLs.
security.verification: Tests with absolute, protocol-relative, backslash and encoded URLs are rejected.

security.title: Unsecured endpoints
security.detect: Enumerate routes from code, OpenAPI, framework route dumps and logs; compare to documented intent; look for forgotten, legacy or test endpoints.
security.remediate: Remove unused endpoints; apply default-deny authentication middleware; document intentionally public routes.
security.verification: Route inventory diff test: every route is either explicitly public or requires auth; CI fails on new unclassified routes.

ux.title: Dark mode toggle
ux.detect: Check if design system already has theming tokens; decide if the product needs a toggle at all.
ux.remediate: Respect prefers-color-scheme by default; offer an explicit toggle persisted in a non-sensitive preference; use CSS variables; avoid flash of wrong theme.
ux.verification: Contrast check in both themes; keyboard operable toggle with aria-pressed; no flash on reload; works with JS disabled via media query.

ux.title: Cookie banner and preferences
ux.detect: Inventory cookies/trackers and applicable regimes (e.g. GDPR/ePrivacy, UK PECR, CCPA/CPRA); banner only if non-essential tracking exists.
ux.remediate: Block non-essential scripts until consent; equal-prominence accept/reject; granular preferences; persistent re-open link; store consent record.
ux.verification: Network test: no analytics/ad requests before consent; reject path works; preferences reachable from footer. Legal sufficiency needs counsel.

ux.title: Site search
ux.detect: Decide if content volume justifies search; pick static index (e.g. Pagefind-style) or backend search.
ux.remediate: Labelled search input, debounced queries, empty/error/loading states, escaped result rendering, rate-limited backend endpoint.
ux.verification: Keyboard test; XSS payload in query renders inert; empty and error states visible; no-results message.

ux.title: Back-to-top button
ux.detect: Only add for long pages; check it does not overlap sticky UI or floating contact action.
ux.remediate: Real button with accessible name; appears after scroll threshold; honour prefers-reduced-motion; move focus sensibly.
ux.verification: Keyboard/focus test; reduced-motion test; no overlap on mobile viewports.

ux.title: Mobile navigation
ux.detect: Check breakpoints and existing nav component.
ux.remediate: Button with aria-expanded/aria-controls; focus management and Escape to close; touch targets at least 24px (aim 44px); works without hover.
ux.verification: Test at 320px width and with keyboard and screen-reader smoke test; focus returns to trigger on close.

ux.title: Loading animations and skeleton states
ux.detect: Identify async views and their loading, empty, error and success states.
ux.remediate: Skeletons matching final layout to prevent layout shift; aria-busy/live region for status; timeouts with retry; respect reduced motion.
ux.verification: Throttled-network test; CLS measurement; error state visible when request fails.

ux.title: Hover and focus states
ux.detect: Check all interactive elements for visible focus and non-hover alternatives.
ux.remediate: Visible :focus-visible styles with sufficient contrast; hover never the only affordance; consistent states for disabled/active.
ux.verification: Tab through each page; automated axe-style check; focus indicator contrast verified.

ux.title: Scroll progress bar
ux.detect: Only for long-form content; confirm it adds value.
ux.remediate: Decorative element (aria-hidden) or progress role if informative; use passive scroll listeners or CSS scroll timelines with fallback; reduced motion.
ux.verification: No scroll jank in performance profile; hidden from assistive tech if decorative.

ux.title: Copy-to-clipboard button
ux.detect: Identify code blocks, codes, links worth copying.
ux.remediate: Native button with accessible name; navigator.clipboard with fallback and permission handling; announce success via live region; never auto-copy sensitive data.
ux.verification: Works on HTTPS; failure state shown; screen-reader announcement; no secret content copied unintentionally.

ux.title: Print stylesheet
ux.detect: Check pages users plausibly print (articles, receipts, docs).
ux.remediate: @media print rules: hide nav/ads/interactive widgets, readable fonts, show link URLs where useful, avoid page breaks inside blocks.
ux.verification: Print preview/PDF render check for key page types.

ux.title: Sticky headers
ux.detect: Check header height versus viewport and anchor links.
ux.remediate: Use position: sticky with scroll-padding-top so anchors and focus are not hidden; keep compact on mobile; ensure focus not obscured (WCAG 2.2).
ux.verification: Keyboard focus never hidden under header; 400% zoom check; anchor jump check.

ux.title: Skip-to-content link
ux.detect: Check first focusable element on every layout.
ux.remediate: First focusable link targeting main landmark id; visible on focus; main has tabindex=-1 if needed.
ux.verification: Tab once from page load: link appears and moves focus to main content.

ux.title: Password visibility toggle
ux.detect: Check auth forms and password-manager compatibility.
ux.remediate: Toggle button with accessible name and state; keep input type switching safe; correct autocomplete attributes; do not log or persist value.
ux.verification: Keyboard and screen-reader test; password manager still fills; value not exposed in DOM attributes or analytics.

ux.title: UTM tracking
ux.detect: Decide whether campaign tracking is needed and whether consent is required.
ux.remediate: Parse utm_* parameters only after consent where required; allowlist keys, length-limit and encode values; never store personal data in UTM values; strip from canonical URLs.
ux.verification: Test: payload in utm_source renders inert and is not stored raw; no tracking before consent.

ux.title: Form success states
ux.detect: Identify all submit paths and what the user needs to know afterwards.
ux.remediate: Clear confirmation message in a live region, preserved context, next step, prevention of duplicate submits, no sensitive echo.
ux.verification: Submit test confirms message announced to screen readers and double-click does not duplicate.

ux.title: Form error states
ux.detect: Review validation messaging and server error mapping.
ux.remediate: Inline errors associated via aria-describedby, error summary with focus, specific actionable text, server-side validation as authority, no sensitive details in messages.
ux.verification: Invalid, empty and server-error submissions tested; errors announced; focus moves to summary or first error.

ux.title: Confirmation dialogs
ux.detect: Identify destructive or irreversible actions.
ux.remediate: Use accessible modal (focus trap, Escape, restores focus, role=dialog/alertdialog) with explicit action labels; consider undo instead of confirm; server enforces authorization regardless.
ux.verification: Keyboard test; cancel is safe default; destructive action still requires server-side authorization.

ux.title: Accurate last-updated date
ux.detect: Find hard-coded or build-time dates and decide what 'updated' means.
ux.remediate: Derive from real content change (git commit, CMS timestamp), machine-readable <time datetime>, align with structured data dateModified; never auto-bump without change.
ux.verification: Change content and confirm date changes; unchanged content keeps date.

ux.title: Expandable FAQ
ux.detect: Check content is genuinely Q&A; consider native details/summary.
ux.remediate: Prefer <details>/<summary> or button with aria-expanded/aria-controls; content crawlable; optional FAQ structured data only when it matches visible content.
ux.verification: Keyboard and screen-reader test; content visible to crawlers; structured-data validator passes.

ux.title: Floating contact action
ux.detect: Check overlap with cookie banner, back-to-top and mobile browser UI.
ux.remediate: Real link/button with accessible name; does not cover content or consent UI; respects safe-area insets; consider whether needed.
ux.verification: Check at small viewports with banner open; keyboard reachable; does not block form fields.

production.title: Privacy policy
production.detect: Inventory personal data collected, processors, retention, transfers, rights and contact details from the actual code and vendors.
production.remediate: Draft a policy matching real behaviour; flag fields needing business input; link from footer and forms. Template text is not legal compliance.
production.verification: Compare policy against data inventory; request legal review. Never claim compliance.

production.title: Terms and conditions
production.detect: Identify services, payments, user content, liability and jurisdiction facts.
production.remediate: Draft from actual product facts; mark gaps for owner and counsel; link at signup/checkout.
production.verification: Owner and legal review recorded; links reachable.

production.title: Remove frontend secrets
production.detect: Scan bundles and public env prefixes.
production.remediate: Move privileged operations to the server; rotate leaked keys.
production.verification: Production build scan clean; see SEC-14.

production.title: Enforce HTTPS
production.detect: Check redirects from HTTP, mixed content, certificate validity and renewal.
production.remediate: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS at the edge; enable HSTS after validation; fix mixed content; automate renewal.
production.verification: curl -I http://… shows redirect; browser console shows no mixed content; certificate expiry monitored.

production.title: Cookie consent where applicable
production.detect: Determine if non-essential cookies/trackers exist and which regimes apply.
production.remediate: Implement consent gating only where needed; see UX-02.
production.verification: No non-essential requests before consent.

production.title: Meta titles and descriptions
production.detect: Crawl pages for missing, duplicate, over- or under-length titles/descriptions.
production.remediate: Unique title and description per page generated from real content.
production.verification: Crawler script/lint finds no missing or duplicate values.

production.title: Social preview image
production.detect: Check og:image/twitter:image presence, size and absolute URL.
production.remediate: Provide properly sized image with alt text and absolute URL; per-page where valuable.
production.verification: Inspect rendered meta tags; test with platform debuggers manually.

production.title: Favicon
production.detect: Check favicon.ico, SVG/PNG and touch icon links.
production.remediate: Provide multiple sizes and web manifest where needed.
production.verification: Requests for icon URLs return 200 with correct type.

production.title: Sitemap and robots.txt
production.detect: Check presence, accuracy, absolute URLs, and that private/non-prod areas are not exposed.
production.remediate: Generate sitemap from routes; robots.txt references sitemap; remember robots.txt is not access control.
production.verification: Fetch both files; validate URLs return 200; staging disallowed and authenticated.

production.title: Image alt text
production.detect: Find images without alt or with filename-like alt.
production.remediate: Meaningful alt for informative images, empty alt for decorative, text alternatives for complex images.
production.verification: Lint/axe finds no missing alt; manual spot check of quality.

production.title: Image compression
production.detect: List large images and formats in build output.
production.remediate: Modern formats (WebP/AVIF) with fallbacks, responsive srcset, lazy loading below fold, explicit width/height.
production.verification: Build report sizes compared to budget; Lighthouse image audits.

production.title: Page-load performance checks
production.detect: Measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and bundle size lab and field where available.
production.remediate: Set budgets; reduce blocking scripts; code split; cache headers; fonts strategy.
production.verification: Run Lighthouse or equivalent before/after and record numbers; lab results do not equal field results.

production.title: Color contrast
production.detect: Check text and UI component contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text/UI).
production.remediate: Adjust tokens; do not rely on colour alone.
production.verification: Automated checker plus manual review of states and both themes.

production.title: Mobile responsiveness
production.detect: Test viewports from 320px; check horizontal scroll, tap targets, zoom.
production.remediate: Responsive layout with relative units; viewport meta; avoid disabling zoom.
production.verification: Viewport sweep (320, 375, 768, 1280) with screenshots or automated checks.

production.title: Custom 404 page
production.detect: Request a non-existent URL and inspect status and body.
production.remediate: Branded helpful 404 with navigation/search, real 404 status (not soft 404), no internal details.
production.verification: curl -i shows 404; page has no stack trace; links work.

production.title: Broken-link checks
production.detect: Crawl internal links and critical external links.
production.remediate: Fix or redirect broken links; add 301s for moved pages; run link checker in CI with a polite crawl rate.
production.verification: Link-checker output shows zero broken internal links.

production.title: Form validation
production.detect: Review client and server validation parity.
production.remediate: Server-side validation authoritative; client-side for UX; accessible messages; see SEC-16.
production.verification: Invalid inputs rejected on server regardless of client.

production.title: Spam protection
production.detect: Check public forms for abuse controls.
production.remediate: Layered: rate limiting, honeypot, server verification of challenge tokens (privacy-aware CAPTCHA if justified), email verification where appropriate.
production.verification: Automated submissions bounded; verification done server-side; legitimate users not blocked in test.

production.title: Analytics configuration
production.detect: Inventory analytics tags, data collected, consent dependency, IP handling and retention.
production.remediate: Configure minimal events, consent gating where required, anonymisation settings, no PII in event payloads.
production.verification: Network inspection before/after consent; test property receives expected events only after consent.

production.title: Clear primary call to action
production.detect: Identify the page's single main goal and current CTA prominence.
production.remediate: One visually primary, descriptive CTA above the fold; consistent across pages; accessible and trackable.
production.verification: Stakeholder confirms goal; click path tested on mobile and desktop.

production.title: Deployment checks
production.detect: Review env config parity, migrations, health checks, feature flags and secrets injection.
production.remediate: Pre-deploy checklist, health endpoint, staged rollout where feasible; human approval for production deploys.
production.verification: Checklist completed with evidence; smoke tests post-deploy.

production.title: Security headers
production.detect: See SEC-46.
production.remediate: See SEC-46.
production.verification: See SEC-46.

production.title: Safe error handling
production.detect: See SEC-12; check user-facing error pages.
production.remediate: Generic messages, correlation IDs, no internals.
production.verification: Forced error tests.

production.title: Dependency audits
production.detect: See SEC-37.
production.remediate: See SEC-37.
production.verification: Audit output attached.

production.title: Monitoring
production.detect: See SEC-43; add uptime, error-rate and latency checks.
production.remediate: Uptime probe, error tracking, alert ownership.
production.verification: Synthetic failure triggers alert.

production.title: Backups and restore testing
production.detect: See SEC-44.
production.remediate: Automated backups; scheduled restore drills.
production.verification: Restore drill result recorded.

production.title: Rollback planning
production.detect: Check ability to revert code, config and schema changes.
production.remediate: Document rollback steps, keep previous artifact, use backwards-compatible migrations, define decision owner.
production.verification: Rollback rehearsed in staging; time to roll back measured.
